data.long_meaning: From the Old English hæsel, 'hazel tree'. Its root is Old English hæsel. A modern English given name. Hazel is a English name meaning “Hazel tree; the colour hazel”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.etymology: From the Old English hæsel, 'hazel tree'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hazel total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
